note: SCG I.18 n.4 says the composer is the efficient cause of the composite, with no temporal qualifier. The premise's EfficientlyCausesIn is efficient causing here and now (DEF-EFFICIENT-CAUSING), so the premise also says that every uniter, including one whose uniting is past, is a present efficient cause of the composite in some respect. The source does not state that temporal step (Codex review on #995). Closing the gap would take a bridge from having composed to causing now, or a time-neutral premise.
